home: Worldwide Education Foundation — Empowering Communities Through Education in Chitral

Worldwide Education Foundation (WEF) invests in the potential of children and youth across underserved communities in Chitral, Pakistan through early childhood development, teacher training, English language learning, and scholarships.

Integrating Early Childhood Development and Technology-Assisted English Language Labs into government primary schools across Chitral.
model-schools: Government Model Schools — Worldwide Education Foundation
Transforming government primary school classrooms in Upper Chitral into welcoming, developmentally appropriate learning spaces.
language-labs: In-School Language Labs — Worldwide Education Foundation
High-quality English language labs in low-income private schools across Chitral, strengthening students' speaking and listening skills.
teacher-training: English Language Skills Training for Teachers — Worldwide Education Foundation
A TEFL micro-credential certification program for teachers in the remote valley of Booni, Chitral, in partnership with Bridge Education Group.
research-hub: Herzing–Daya Research & Learning Hub — Worldwide Education Foundation
Pakistan's first ECD research hub in a remote mountain region, hosted at the University of Chitral and led by WEF.
secondary-scholarships: Secondary School Scholarships — Worldwide Education Foundation
Investing in Young Futures: removing financial barriers for underserved students in Upper Chitral to continue their education beyond Grade 8.
rising-stars: AM Rising Stars Undergraduate Scholarship — Worldwide Education Foundation
Removing financial barriers to higher education for talented students from Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan, funded by Sadiq Ali & Family.

An integrated platform for professional development, teacher training, and workforce readiness hosted at the University of Chitral.
